description: View body uses WITH cte AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ...) followed by a multi-JOIN SELECT that projects columns from the JOINed tables (v.id AS version_id, v.status AS version_status, v.email AS version_email). Regression test: previously the parser's expression terminator set did not include JOIN-introducing keywords, so the ON expression of the first JOIN swallowed the next JOIN clause. That dropped the second JOIN (account_versions v) from the view's parsed JoinClauses, leaving the scope chain unaware of `v` and degrading every projected v.* column to TypeCategoryAny. The fix adds JOIN/INNER/LEFT/RIGHT/FULL/CROSS/NATURAL to the expression terminator set so chained JOINs are parsed correctly and v.id, v.status, v.email resolve to uuid, text, text respectively.
